digest.component_or_area: Plan review and ticket lifecycle / Jira reconciler
key_entities: RP-03 outbound lifecycle protocol and Jira failure handling
RP-05 CLI registry and help routing
RP-06 plan-review policy and code-review kernel
propositions: Five interdependent architectural recovery proposals (RP-02 through RP-06) from a 2026-08-16 janitor plan require evidence-backed derisk research and maintainer approval before becoming tracked implementation stories.

RP-02 establishes ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary with safety-abort on ambiguity, preserving RP-03's consumption of coherent post-recovery snapshots without duplicating binding persistence.

RP-03 owns scoped failure classification, authoritative Jira rate/auth/config scopes, singular retry ownership (3 physical invocations max, 15s cumulative sleep), observe/replan cycles, and finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive or 5-of-10 exhausted provider-suspect outcomes across >=2 tickets).

RP-04 supplies resolved operation authority with explicit precedence (CLI > environment > project > user > default), per-operation snapshot, secret/provider boundary, and corrected tracker-path ownership.

RP-05 addresses CLI registry capability/routing with one pending choice on normalizing advanced help verbs; RP-06 addresses plan-review effective applicability, code-review kernel routing divergence, and failed-checkpoint persistence.

All behavior changes must be explicitly classified as PRESERVE, APPROVED DELTA, CORRECTIVE-TO-CONFIRM, CHOICE PENDING, or DEPENDENCY CONSTRAINT in decision-ready briefs; cross-RP dependencies are RP-03←RP-02, RP-03←RP-04, RP-01→RP-06 (via runtime accounting).
